changes: Shared calendar-date and HH:mm validators are used by managed forms, repository writes and backup parsing.

Category duplicate checks and writes execute synchronously in a transaction using the same normalization as backup parsing.
Legacy targets retain categoryId=null instead of being assigned a synthetic career category.
Removing a managed daily priority records excludedFocusDates in the same transaction as deleting the relation.
Auto-add skips excluded dates; explicit add clears the date exclusion. Task metadata and core records remain.
The optional exclusion field preserves old backup compatibility; no SQLite schema or backup format version changes.
